lines: Nor smell and touch: qualitied, they fail
where the qualitied is absent — the effect-chain
l4.sanskrit_cite: nāpi gandhasparśau mukhyau guṇinaḥ tatra abhāve tayor ayogāt kāryaparamparānārambhāt ca

reads_against.argmap: Why are gandha and sparśa not primary either? → Qualitied means dependent-on-substrate; dependence disqualifies primacy for both.
c1_essence: Smell and touch lose primacy too: qualitied, they fail where the qualitied is absent — the effect-chain never starts from them.
